title: Prop firm challenge math in R (hook C: reframe)

channel.name: Andrew Builds (TradeNotes)
channel.appBlurb: a trading journal and performance analytics app

body.hook: Risk two hundred, make five hundred. That's not a three hundred dollar win. It's plus two point five R.
body.promise: Try measuring your trades in R.

beats.narration: One R is what you planned to lose on the trade. Five hundred divided by two hundred.
Say a challenge has a ten percent target, ten percent max loss and a five percent daily limit. At one percent risk, that's ten R to win, ten losses to fail.
Drop to half a percent and it's twenty R to win, but twenty losses to fail. Rules differ between firms, so check yours. Trading involves risk of loss.

body.cta: I built TradeNotes, so I'm biased, but there's a free R-multiple and challenge calculator. Link in my pinned comment. Not financial advice.
